notes.title: ShipCrafter now has various bot behaviours
notes.content: [p]Hello,[/p][p]A new update has made its way in ShipCrafter. This time in particular we have different bot behaviours. You can choose how your ship should react when controlled by a bot between going broadside, trying to reach a target, align and torpedo targets like a submarine, or try to flee.[/p][p][/p][p]Bigger waves to play with were also requested, so now a new weather can be selected in custom battle with enormous waves ![/p][p][/p][p]Here is the complete list of changes :[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]made guard rails thicker,[/p][/*][*][p]added angled column cosmetic,[/p][/*][*][p]changed guns sound strength depending on caliber,[/p][/*][*][p]added screen mode and screen resolution control in settings,[/p][/*][*][p]slightly optimised scene loading,[/p][/*][*][p]added maximum waves size in weather options for custom battles,[/p][/*][*][p]implemented ship behaviours, allowing to choose how a ship should fight when controlled by a bot,[/p][/*][*][p]it is now impossible to lock a submerged target[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]See you soon for another update ![/p]

notes.title: It's been a month since last update, and many new things got in ShipCrafter
notes.content:
[p]Hello ![/p][p][/p][p]Yes it has already been a month without a community post, but rest assured the game kept being updated in the meantime.[/p][p]In particular we now have fully configurable custom missions. It is now possible to select allied bots, the time of day, the weather, and even to view bot vs bot battles in spectator mode. Also bots are now able to use torpedos as well, making battle more diverse and challenging.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45694800/ed56b3231b19ce7615f412744aea8cc3f2e478b9.png"][/img][/p][p]A mirror mode was added to the build scene as well, making ship building twice as fast.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45694800/2dd3891afb3c822228594f3b06e26732b65fb161.png"][/img][/p][p]Cosmetics can now be stretched and shifted to allow more variations in your build.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45694800/6ba958542ad6025ee08b6a5f034fcd6790e47b87.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Finally, many ships were completed in prevision of the release. Here are a few select pictures of them :
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45694800/0dbee645caff43fd2b2563a0d5161b0318fb15f2.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45694800/0fd3cd2208e05cf6701429d0202330b641ca2327.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45694800/6bab17ae9b9543aa26e5a741cd77dccad38fbb6e.png"][/img][/p][p]That's it for this log, of course many bugs were fixed and lots small features were added as well.[/p][p]See you for the next post ![/p]

notes.title: A new update comes in ShipCrafter
notes.content: [p]Hello, a new update is now available ! Here are the changes : [/p][list][*][p]added special mission types : one is available in the demo, the Minekaze, along with its unlockable armament,[/p][/*][*][p]added mission type : defense of point against raiding enemies (mission n°7),[/p][/*][*][p]first person view in battles and custom battles, even allowiing you to aim and shoot in this view,[/p][/*][*][p]anchor cosmetic,[/p][/*][*][p]changed build scene esthetics, it should be clearer and more optimised,[/p][/*][*][p]changed weaponery naming,[/p][/*][*][p]changed barriers and column cosmetics,[/p][/*][*][p]improved canons VFX[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45694800/08117b17a0c7fb525942ba12dc60fa5a1963b181.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45694800/53ffb7c2c27bc8bd66a7340625a6909be974425a.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: ShipCrafter demo is now live !
notes.content: [p][/p][p]Hello everyone ![/p][p]The first demo version of ShipCrafter is now live. As this is our first build, the game is not fully fleshed out yet, but you can already build ships and fight the first few missions of the campaign, and use the custom battle editor.[/p][p]If you have suggestions for the game, you can let me know in the official discord ! More updates are coming, including this time terrains, wiring cosmetics, and more.[/p][p][/p][p]For the content creators out there, here is a link towards a press kit : [/p][p][url="https://github.com/Myrmecoman/ShipCrafter-Presskit"]https://github.com/Myrmecoman/ShipCrafter-Presskit[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Have fun ![/p]
